en: Black‑and‑white view across a calm river or pond toward a small European town. In the foreground is a rectangular, brick‑lined island planted with a tree and flowering shrubs. Along the opposite bank are orchards, gardens, and a simple wooden fence, behind which stand several houses: one plastered masonry house with a steep tiled roof, another timber‑framed house, and additional dwellings partly obscured by trees. In the background, above the tree line, rise two church towers or spires attached to large roofed buildings, suggesting prominent churches or a monastery complex. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
